Results.ReviewText: We've had Weber grills for over 30-years and needed to downsize a little.  This is a great grill once together.  The instructions lack basic information regarding the hardware.  The E-310 apparently requires more screws than the E-210, yet the instructions only state that some grills require less screws than others (duh!).  Well, about half-way through putting it together, I (thought I) ran out of screws.  I called Weber and the person only offered to send me more screws without once noting they may be in different bags (which they were).  The instructions should state that if the screws in Bag A are depleted and you need more, they are in other bags combined with other screws.  Remedial stuff in my opinion.  Using the BILT App is really worthwhile.
Results.Title: Great grill - instructions lacking
